articles.title: Mantle adds Paxos’ USDG stablecoin, joins Global Dollar Network
articles.snippet: Mantle has added Paxos-issued USDG as a natively minted stablecoin while joining the network’s reward-sharing structure.

articles.title: Kraken parent Payward partners with SoFi on stablecoin, 24/7 settlement
articles.snippet: The deal will bring SoFiUSD to Kraken, connect Payward to SoFi’s 24/7 dollar settlement network and give SoFi access to digital asset liquidity through Kraken Prime.

articles.title: Wyoming adds Chainlink reserve verification to state-issued stable token
articles.snippet: Wyoming is using Chainlink to bring near-real-time reserve verification onchain for FRNT as the oracle provider expands its footprint across tokenized financial markets.

articles.title: SoFi Links Banking Network and Stablecoin to Kraken in New Deal
articles.snippet: Kraken will list SoFiUSD and gain access to SoFi’s round-the-clock dollar settlement network, while Kraken Prime will execute trades for SoFi’s crypto customers.

articles.title: Goldman Sachs, BofA Among 21 Banks Planning Joint Dollar Stablecoin Launch
articles.snippet: The bank-led consortium wants a U.S. dollar token live by the first half of 2027, with a euro version queued up next.
